metadata.scope: Verified historical flood and landslide replay events
metadata.geometry_note: Event evidence and geometry are separate: event occurrence comes from authoritative reports; OSM settlement centroids provide spatial anchors.

properties.evidence_source: Himachal Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority, Post Disaster Needs Assessment Monsoon 2023; Sphere India Himachal Pradesh Floods July 2023 assessment
properties.evidence_note: July 7-11 2023 extreme rainfall/flood spell; Pandoh, Mandi documented as significantly affected by flooding.

properties.evidence_source: Geological Survey of India, Landslides in Mandi District, Himachal Pradesh on July, August and September 2023
properties.evidence_note: GSI reports a debris slide near HPPWD Circuit House at Tarna Hill on 14 August 2023.
properties.geometry_precision: Mandi settlement centroid; Tarna Hill event location represented approximately
